# Content-Graph Worker Service

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.worker` |
| Source | `09_docker/worker.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, workers |

Generic content-graph worker built locally. Pulls jobs from
Redis/Temporal and uses Postgres, MinIO, Tika, Unstructured, Qdrant,
and Ollama via configurable URLs. Demonstrates a `docker.base` child
that ships both a generated Dockerfile and additional source files
(`app/worker.py`) alongside the compose document.
